numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across seasons: Season 1 is 1-12 and Season 2 (Arise from the Shadow) is 13-25 (Anime Filler Guide numbering).

arcs.name: Double Dungeon
arcs.summary: Sung Jinwoo, known as the weakest E-rank hunter, joins a raid on a low-level dungeon that turns out to hide a deadly secret chamber.
events: The raid party finds a temple of statues that kill anyone who breaks its commandments.
Jinwoo stays behind so the others can escape and is nearly killed.
Jinwoo wakes in hospital with a mysterious System that only he can see.

arcs.name: Becoming the Player
arcs.summary: Using the System's daily quests and instant dungeons, Jinwoo grows stronger in secret while still posing as an E-rank hunter.
events: Jinwoo levels up through daily quests and penalty zones.
Other hunters betray him during raids, and he kills them in self-defense.
Jinwoo hides his rapid growth from the Hunter Association.

arcs.name: Job Change Quest
arcs.summary: The System offers Jinwoo a class-change trial, a lone fight against a legion of knights.
events: Jinwoo faces the knight commander Igris.
Jinwoo earns the hidden Necromancer class and gains the power to raise the dead as shadows.

arcs.name: Red Gate and Demon Castle
arcs.summary: Jinwoo, now able to command shadows, gets trapped in a dangerous red gate and keeps climbing toward a cure for his comatose mother.
events: Jinwoo is trapped in a Red Gate with other hunters and fights his way out.
Jinwoo climbs the Demon Castle in search of an elixir for his mother.
Jinwoo is reassessed and revealed to be an S-rank hunter.

arcs.name: Jeju Island
arcs.summary: Korea's top guilds mount a raid on Jeju Island, overrun by ants after an earlier raid failed badly.
events: The S-rank hunters of Korea and Japan plan the raid together.
A newly born Ant King, Beru, overwhelms the raid team.
Jinwoo arrives on the island to confront the Ant King.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the source comic.
